messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: algebraic number-theoretic construction using roots of unity

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "Let ζ = e^(2πi/13) and define points p_k = (cos(2πk/13) + 1)/2, (sin(2πk/13) + 1)/2) for k = 0, ..., 11, scaled and translated into the unit square, with the 13th point at (1/2, 1/2). The cyclotomic structure of the 13th roots of unity forces the 286 triangles formed by all triples to have minimum area at least sin(2π/13)/8 ≈ 0.09465, because any collinearity among subsets would imply a forbidden additive relation among the roots of unity that the degree-12 cyclotomic field Φ_13 does not admit."}
